summary: Tested backend APIs (pytest, 10/10 passed) and frontend end-to-end flows (registration + admin) for LKP HReDU course registration app. All critical flows work: courses list returns 4 items, public registration with multipart file upload succeeds, invalid file types and >10MB uploads return 400, admin key gating works (401 on missing/wrong key, 200 with hredu2024), admin table lists registrations, search & course filter narrow results, bukti download returns image bytes, and clicking a course card prefills the kursus select and scrolls to the form.
critical_code_review_comments: RegistrationForm stores the course title (option value = c.title) as `kursus` in DB. Admin course filter compares against titles, so any records inserted with course ID (e.g. via API tests) won't match a title-based filter. Consider storing course id and displaying title, or filtering by id, for consistency.
storage_key is a module-level global with no locking; concurrent uploads that trigger re-init could race but not critical for MVP.
server.py init_storage() uses blocking requests inside async handlers (put_object/get_object); acceptable for MVP but consider httpx/async for scale.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 TEST_ prefixed registrations via API and UI for testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 10 tests). Frontend Landing uses data-testid course-card-{id}; clicking its inner button prefills kursus. Kursus <select> option values are course TITLE, not id. File input is native <input type=file>; use `input[type=file]` selector (data-testid on wrapping label works via querySelector but not for set_input_files).
